eventDetail.scope: ISIE is the flagship annual symposium of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society (IES). It provides an international platform for researchers, engineers, and industry professionals to share and discuss the latest innovations in areas such as power electronics, intelligent control, renewable energy, robotics, smart manufacturing, communications, and artificial intelligence. We welcome both completed research with new findings and innovative work-in-progress.
